crossRefs.note: His name endures forever. His name continues as long as the sun. Men shall be blessed by him. All nations will call him…
Praise Yahweh, my soul! All that is within me, praise his holy name!
Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the…
You are my hiding place. You will preserve me from trouble. You will surround me with songs of deliverance.
How precious to me are your thoughts, God! How vast is their sum!
They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.

translations.web: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burdens, even the God who is our salvation.
translations.bsb: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burden, the God of our salvation. Selah
translations.kjv: Blessed be the Lord, who daily loadeth us with benefits, even the God of our salvation. Selah.
translations.asv: Blessed be the Lord, who daily beareth our burden, Even the God who is our salvation. Selah
